query: SELECT u.credential_id AS "credential_id!", coalesce(sum(u.cost), 0) AS "cost!", coalesce(sum(u.requests - u.errors), 0)::bigint AS "requests!" FROM usage_daily u JOIN provider_credentials c ON c.id = u.credential_id AND c.org_id = u.org_id WHERE u.org_id = $1 AND u.day >= $2 AND u.day <= $3 AND c.auth_method = 'linked_billing' GROUP BY u.credential_id ORDER BY u.credential_id
